request: Define and implement IMA as an OTA update plane so routine software evolution does not require users to reinstall, while respecting OS/store security boundaries.
action: Inspected the existing public deployment and found that canonical Pages already stamps the exact main SHA into version.json and verifies it before publishing.
Found the IMA PWA already refreshes its service worker, but the version check was duplicated inline in index.html.

Added a centralized updateCoordinator that polls version.json, detects a newer verified build, reloads automatically, handles visibility changes, and uses a one-shot session guard against reload loops.

Removed the duplicate inline version checker and documented the cross-platform IMA OTA Update Plane: automatic for IMA-controlled web/PWA and backend components; platform-permitted channels for native apps and OS components; owner-scoped signed update protocol for future IMA device bridges.
